purpose: Verify the training path on a small sample of the BGE-M3 hybrid MIRACL Arabic teacher data before scaling.

environment.note: The first smoke attempt failed before training because transformers 4.44.2 was incompatible with sentence-transformers 5.5.1; upgrading transformers to 4.57.6 fixed Trainer processing_class support.

eval_sample.sample: 50 queries / 1000 docs positive-plus-negatives sample; not comparable to full MIRACL results.

interpretation: The training stack now works on the remote L20 after fixing the sentence-transformers/transformers version mismatch.
A 64-row plain MultipleNegativesRankingLoss smoke completed quickly and produced a checkpoint.
The same-seed 50-query/1000-doc MIRACL Arabic sample regressed by -0.008523 nDCG@10 versus the base BGE-M3 model.
This sample is not a leaderboard metric, but it is enough to reject simply scaling this plain MNR self-training recipe.
next_experiment: Implement a teacher-score-aware distillation smoke, such as MarginMSE over query/positive/negative triples or a FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 distillation path, before any larger training run.
